description: We are B3B08, a team of 3rd-year Computer Engineering students from Muğla Sıtkı Koçman University (MSKÜ) tackling the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge.
summary:
Muğla GeoInsight is an AI-powered Spatial Decision Support System (SDSS) developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge’s “Dancing with the SARs” challenge. The platform brings together satellite observations, geospatial analysis, and artificial intelligence to monitor environmental changes across all 13 districts of Muğla, Türkiye.

By combining radar data from Sentinel-1 (SAR) with multispectral optical data from Sentinel-2, GeoInsight supports the analysis of environmental processes such as ground movement, wildfires, drought, water resource changes, coastal transformation, agricultural conditions, and urban expansion.

The platform transforms complex satellite-derived indicators into interactive maps, visual analyses, contextual insights, and reports that help users understand environmental changes over time. Its AI-assisted interface makes geospatial information more accessible and supports informed decision-making.

GeoInsight addresses the challenge by demonstrating how SAR observations can contribute to understanding real-world environmental changes when combined with complementary satellite data. It is important because timely, accessible, and geographically detailed environmental information can help local authorities, researchers, and communities better understand risks and support more sustainable land and resource management.
details: Development technologies: JavaScript, Node.js, JSON-based data structures, and web technologies. Benefits and Intended Impact GeoInsight aims to make satellite-based environmental intelligence more accessible to local authorities, researchers, agricultural stakeholders, urban planners, and environmental organizations. Its monitoring modules address a broad range of environmental challenges, including wildfires, drought, agricultural stress, water resource changes, coastal transformation, ground movement, flooding, mining activities, and urban expansion. By bringing different environmental indicators together in one platform, the project helps users identify patterns, understand changes over time, and prioritize areas for further investigation. Its intended impact is to support more informed environmental planning, improve awareness of regional risks, and contribute to sustainable land and natural resource management. Creativity and Innovation The innovative aspect of Muğla GeoInsight is not simply displaying satellite imagery on a map, but connecting satellite observations, geospatial analysis, and AI-assisted interpretation within a unified decision-support environment. Instead of requiring users to understand complex remote sensing datasets independently, GeoInsight presents environmental information through interactive visualizations, contextual explanations, and structured reports. Its multi-module architecture also allows different environmental challenges to be examined within the same geographical framework. Factors Considered During Development Our team considered Muğla's geographical diversity, Mediterranean climate, agricultural areas, forest ecosystems, coastal settlements, water resources, and growing urban areas. We focused on making the platform geographically relevant, understandable, modular, and useful for different stakeholders. We also considered temporal comparisons, spatial resolution, data quality, environmental context, and the importance of distinguishing satellite-derived indicators from field-verified observations. Our vision is to transform Earth observation data into meaningful environmental intelligence and help build a more informed and sustainable future for Muğla.
